en.headline: Assad Brothers bring 60-year farewell recital to City Hall tomorrow
en.dek: The Brazilian classical guitar duo performs at 8pm on 30 October as part of the Asia+ Festival, joined by local guzheng player Wan Xing.
body: The Assad Brothers, Sérgio and Odair, will perform a guitar duo recital at 8pm on Friday at the Concert Hall of Hong Kong City Hall as part of the fourth Asia+ Festival. The concert is a stop on their farewell tour marking 60 years of musical partnership.

The Leisure and Cultural Services Department said the programme includes works by Astor Piazzolla, Heitor Villa-Lobos and original compositions by Sérgio Assad, together with Brazilian pieces less often heard in Hong Kong. Local guzheng virtuoso Wan Xing will join the duo for a piece inspired by the legend of Mulan, marking the China-Brazil Cultural Year.

Tickets priced at $200, $300 and $420 are on sale through URBTIX. The Asia+ Festival is presented by the Culture, Sports and Tourism Bureau and organised by the Leisure and Cultural Services Department.

zh.headline: 阿薩德兄弟60年告別巡演明日大會堂上演
zh.dek: 巴西古典結他二重奏周五晚八時在香港大會堂音樂廳演出，屬第四屆亞藝無疆藝術節節目，本地古筝演奏家萬幸同台。
body: 巴西古典結他二重奏阿薩德兄弟沙治奧及奧迪亞將於周五晚上八時在香港大會堂音樂廳舉行演奏會，作為第四屆「亞藝無疆」藝術節節目，亦是他們合作60周年告別巡演的香港站。
康樂及文化事務署表示，曲目包括皮亞梭拉的探戈作品、魏拉羅伯斯的巴西作品、沙治奧·阿薩德的原創樂曲，以及較少在港演出的巴西旋律。本地古筝演奏家萬幸將與他們合作演出以花木蘭為靈感的曲目，適逢中國巴西文化年。
門票分200元、300元及420元，現於城市售票網發售。「亞藝無疆」藝術節由文化體育及旅遊局呈獻、康樂及文化事務署策劃。
